items.q: Will a better meta title and description improve my rankings?
items.a: They can improve clicks, because a clear title and description make your result more attractive. Google may rewrite them, so keep each page's content aligned with them.

items.q: Can I use the same title on every page?
items.a: No. Give each page its own title and description that match what the page covers.

items.q: Is the meta tag generator free?
items.a: Yes. The meta title and description maker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
